MUML was prevented from commissioning the PK Line due to the uncontrollable events/ force majeure events. In addition to the force majeure events, the implementation was also affected due to hindrance caused by the landowners and to implementation of additional scope of works. MUML approached the Petitioner to resolve the pending issues between the landowners and the Petitioner. Further, with respect to the additional scope of works, the information sought by MUML was provided by the Petitioner belatedly. Therefore, the delays due to the defaults of the Petitioner are not attributable to MUML, and MUML cannot be penalized for the same. - ii. MUML cannot selectively rely on the agreement when convenient and later attempt to disown its commitments. This contradictory stance reflects an attempt to unjustly avoid obligations, and such conduct must be rejected as untenable. - iv.
